class.name: VoxelWorld4D
class.brief_description: A volume of 4D voxel data in the scene tree.
class.description: VoxelWorld4D places a volume of 4D voxel data ([VoxelData]) into the scene tree. It can be used for terrain, but also for smaller voxel-based objects.

method.name: apply_edit
method.description: Applies the edit to this world's voxel data and queues the affected meshes for regeneration. Parts of the edit over chunks that are not loaded are discarded.

members.member: The [VoxelMaterialPalette] describing the materials used for this world.

If [code]true[/code], the world is limited to the bounds given by [member world_bounds_position] and [member world_bounds_size]: chunks entirely outside the bounds are never loaded, and are unloaded if already present. If [code]false[/code], the world can grow without limit.
The lowest corner of the world bounds, in voxel coordinates. Only used while [member world_bounds_enabled] is [code]true[/code].
The size of the world bounds, in voxels, extending from [member world_bounds_position]. Only used while [member world_bounds_enabled] is [code]true[/code].
